notes.1r.33: 1r.1a repeats 'belief' (atrúnaði) and seems out of place; the sentence runs 'And these things belong to heresy and heathen belief'. trollriða, 'troll-rider', is a witch believed to ride people by night; the clause about calling someone one is obscure.

nodes.text: and sorcery; and also if [one] calls any
and believing in land-spirits, that they dwell in groves,
*útisetur* [sitting out at night] to ask about fate, and those
church so that they may find wealth in mounds
or in some other way become mighty
or come to know something. Likewise those
who try to wake up *draugar* [the walking dead]
